# DesignForge

> AI-powered design system generator. Turn natural language prompts into production-ready design tokens, CSS variables, and Tailwind configs in seconds.

DesignForge helps designers and developers generate, version, and export complete design systems — colors, typography, spacing, shadows, and components — with AI assistance and built-in governance.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an account.
- [Dashboard](/app): Generate, edit, and export your design system.

## Optional

- [Settings](/settings): Account and workspace settings.
- [Profile](/profile): Profile management.
